CARGO_KILLED_SCRIPT_MUTATIONS: the policy names the duty of the 26 command replies in its replies list; a misspelt duty leaves every golden an undeclared reply and the list's entry carried by no golden; a string in a JSON file is no cargo-mutants mutation, so a script row
MUTATIONS: replies is a top-level key the loader knows; with it missing from TOP_KEYS (a duplicate keeps the length) parse answers UnknownKey, not Malformed, so A2 fails
check() refuses a replies entry that names a declared kind; without the refusal a reply could be an alert or a nudge
rule (a): a kind-less golden whose duty the policy does not declare a reply is a fault; the planted daily-digest golden is then not refused
rule (b): a replies entry that is the duty of no kind-less golden is a fault; the planted ghost duty is then not refused
